body:
Founder real-time: 'how can we switch to RNN with hand tailored features and a critic with access to privledged info like opponent health' -- hand-tailored-features piece of that plan (founder chose this order: features -> RNN -> asymmetric critic). 10 new terms: relative dx/dy, distance, signed closing velocity, own/opp time-to-any-blast-zone (constant-velocity danger estimate), own/opp facing-toward-opponent, signed damage/stock diffs. OBS_SIZE 21->31, a real, named breaking change for --resume-from-registry against pre-S430 checkpoints -- verified the C side degrades safely (mlp_policy_forward's own existing shape check + ai_opponent_drive's existing no-op-on-mismatch). 7 new tests, full C build+tests pass (./scripts/build.sh + build_training.sh, zero failures). BRAWLPIT commit a6d9243.

⚓ ☃
title: S430: 10 hand-tailored relational observation features
